config_mask_rcnn_xcit_backbone: configure a mask r-cnn model with xcit small 12 patch16 backbone for coco instance segmentation
config_train_pipeline_augmentation: configure a training data pipeline with autoaugment, randomflip, and multiscale resize for instance segmentation
config_optimizer_adamw: configure an adamw optimizer with weight decay and custom parameter decay keys for transformer training
config_lr_schedule_step: configure a step-based learning rate schedule with steps at epochs 27 and 33 for 36 epoch training
config_fp16_dist_optimizer: configure distributed fp16 optimizer hook with gradient clipping disabled and coalesced updates
